"""Tests for CallScriptOrchestrator"""

from unittest.mock import AsyncMock
from unittest.mock import MagicMock
from unittest.mock import Mock
from unittest.mock import patch

import pytest
from livekit.agents import AgentSession
from livekit.agents import JobContext

from commons.enums import TaskAgentInterruptType
from commons.schemas.call_script import CallScript
from commons.schemas.config import EnvironmentConfig
from commons.schemas.task_orchestrator import TaskAgentInterruptRequest
from commons.services.purplefish_client import PurplefishClient
from commons.services import ExternalServiceClients
from tests.voice_agent.conftest import SessionDataState
from voice_agent.utils.orchestrator import CallScriptOrchestrator


class TestCallScriptOrchestrator:
    """Test suite for CallScriptOrchestrator"""

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_initialization(
        self,
        sample_call_script: CallScript,
        mock_agent_session: AgentSession[SessionDataState],
        test_environment_config: EnvironmentConfig,
        mock_agent_room_metadata,
        mock_external_service_clients,
    ):
        """Test orchestrator initialization"""
        on_finish = AsyncMock()

        orchestrator = CallScriptOrchestrator(
            call_script=sample_call_script,
            session=mock_agent_session,
            on_finish_cleanup=on_finish,
            room_name="test-room",
            config=test_environment_config,
            agent_room_metadata=mock_agent_room_metadata,
            external_service_clients=mock_external_service_clients,
        )

        assert orchestrator.session == mock_agent_session
        assert orchestrator.on_finish_cleanup == on_finish
        assert len(orchestrator.outstanding_task_ids) == len(sample_call_script.tasks)
        assert len(orchestrator.in_progress_task_ids) == 0
        assert orchestrator.conversation_context is not None

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_start_orchestrator(
        self,
        sample_call_script: CallScript,
        mock_job_context: JobContext,
        mock_agent_session: AgentSession[SessionDataState],
        test_environment_config: EnvironmentConfig,
        mock_agent_room_metadata,
        mock_external_service_clients,
    ):
        """Test starting the orchestrator"""
        on_finish = AsyncMock()
        mock_agent_session.start = AsyncMock()

        orchestrator = CallScriptOrchestrator(
            call_script=sample_call_script,
            session=mock_agent_session,
            on_finish_cleanup=on_finish,
            room_name="test-room",
            config=test_environment_config,
            agent_room_metadata=mock_agent_room_metadata,
            external_service_clients=mock_external_service_clients,
        )

        await orchestrator.start(mock_job_context, room_input_options=MagicMock())
        mock_agent_session.start.assert_called_once()

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_on_task_agent_finished_success(
        self,
        sample_call_script: CallScript,
        mock_agent_session: AgentSession[SessionDataState],
        test_environment_config: EnvironmentConfig,
        mock_agent_room_metadata,
        mock_external_service_clients,
    ):
        """Test handling task completion successfully"""
        on_finish = AsyncMock()

        orchestrator = CallScriptOrchestrator(
            call_script=sample_call_script,
            session=mock_agent_session,
            on_finish_cleanup=on_finish,
            room_name="test-room",
            config=test_environment_config,
            agent_room_metadata=mock_agent_room_metadata,
            external_service_clients=mock_external_service_clients,
        )

        # Mark first task as in progress
        task = sample_call_script.tasks[0]
        orchestrator.outstanding_task_ids.remove(task.id)
        orchestrator.in_progress_task_ids.append(task.id)

        # Call the hook
        await orchestrator.on_task_agent_finished(task, "Task completed successfully")

        # Should have moved task to completed
        assert task.id in orchestrator.completed_task_ids
        assert task.id not in orchestrator.in_progress_task_ids

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_on_task_agent_interrupt(
        self,
        sample_call_script: CallScript,
        mock_agent_session: AgentSession[SessionDataState],
        test_environment_config: EnvironmentConfig,
        mock_agent_room_metadata,
        mock_external_service_clients,
    ):
        """Test handling task interruption"""
        on_finish = AsyncMock()
        mock_agent_session.generate_reply = AsyncMock()
        orchestrator = CallScriptOrchestrator(
            call_script=sample_call_script,
            session=mock_agent_session,
            on_finish_cleanup=on_finish,
            room_name="test-room",
            config=test_environment_config,
            agent_room_metadata=mock_agent_room_metadata,
            external_service_clients=mock_external_service_clients,
        )
        # Create interrupt request
        interrupt_request = TaskAgentInterruptRequest(
            type=TaskAgentInterruptType.USER_TOPIC_CHANGE,
            interrupt_note="User changed topic",
        )

        # Test topic change doesn't end call
        await orchestrator.on_task_agent_interrupt(interrupt_request)

        # Test end call interrupt
        end_call_request = TaskAgentInterruptRequest(
            type=TaskAgentInterruptType.USER_INITIATE_END_CALL,
            interrupt_note="User wants to end call",
        )

        with patch.object(orchestrator, "done", new=AsyncMock()) as mock_done:
            await orchestrator.on_task_agent_interrupt(end_call_request)
            mock_done.assert_called_once()
            mock_agent_session.generate_reply.assert_called()

"""Tests for CallScriptOrchestrator"""

from unittest.mock import AsyncMock
from unittest.mock import MagicMock
from unittest.mock import Mock
from unittest.mock import patch

import pytest
from livekit.agents import AgentSession
from livekit.agents import JobContext

from commons.enums import TaskAgentInterruptType
from commons.schemas.call_script import CallScript
from commons.schemas.config import EnvironmentConfig
from commons.schemas.task_orchestrator import TaskAgentInterruptRequest
from commons.services.purplefish_client import PurplefishClient
from commons.services import ExternalServiceClients
from tests.voice_agent.conftest import SessionDataState
from voice_agent.utils.orchestrator import CallScriptOrchestrator


class TestCallScriptOrchestrator:
    """Test suite for CallScriptOrchestrator"""

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_initialization(
        self,
        sample_call_script: CallScript,
        mock_agent_session: AgentSession[SessionDataState],
        test_environment_config: EnvironmentConfig,
        mock_agent_room_metadata,
        mock_external_service_clients,
    ):
        """Test orchestrator initialization"""
        on_finish = AsyncMock()

        orchestrator = CallScriptOrchestrator(
            call_script=sample_call_script,
            session=mock_agent_session,
            on_finish_cleanup=on_finish,
            room_name="test-room",
            config=test_environment_config,
            agent_room_metadata=mock_agent_room_metadata,
            external_service_clients=mock_external_service_clients,
        )

        assert orchestrator.session == mock_agent_session
        assert orchestrator.on_finish_cleanup == on_finish
        assert len(orchestrator.outstanding_task_ids) == len(sample_call_script.tasks)
        assert len(orchestrator.in_progress_task_ids) == 0
        assert orchestrator.conversation_context is not None

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_start_orchestrator(
        self,
        sample_call_script: CallScript,
        mock_job_context: JobContext,
        mock_agent_session: AgentSession[SessionDataState],
        test_environment_config: EnvironmentConfig,
        mock_agent_room_metadata,
        mock_external_service_clients,
    ):
        """Test starting the orchestrator"""
        on_finish = AsyncMock()
        mock_agent_session.start = AsyncMock()

        orchestrator = CallScriptOrchestrator(
            call_script=sample_call_script,
            session=mock_agent_session,
            on_finish_cleanup=on_finish,
            room_name="test-room",
            config=test_environment_config,
            agent_room_metadata=mock_agent_room_metadata,
            external_service_clients=mock_external_service_clients,
        )

        await orchestrator.start(mock_job_context, room_input_options=MagicMock())
        mock_agent_session.start.assert_called_once()

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_on_task_agent_finished_success(
        self,
        sample_call_script: CallScript,
        mock_agent_session: AgentSession[SessionDataState],
        test_environment_config: EnvironmentConfig,
        mock_agent_room_metadata,
        mock_external_service_clients,
    ):
        """Test handling task completion successfully"""
        on_finish = AsyncMock()

        orchestrator = CallScriptOrchestrator(
            call_script=sample_call_script,
            session=mock_agent_session,
            on_finish_cleanup=on_finish,
            room_name="test-room",
            config=test_environment_config,
            agent_room_metadata=mock_agent_room_metadata,
            external_service_clients=mock_external_service_clients,
        )

        # Mark first task as in progress
        task = sample_call_script.tasks[0]
        orchestrator.outstanding_task_ids.remove(task.id)
        orchestrator.in_progress_task_ids.append(task.id)

        # Call the hook
        await orchestrator.on_task_agent_finished(task, "Task completed successfully")

        # Should have moved task to completed
        assert task.id in orchestrator.completed_task_ids
        assert task.id not in orchestrator.in_progress_task_ids

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_on_task_agent_interrupt(
        self,
        sample_call_script: CallScript,
        mock_agent_session: AgentSession[SessionDataState],
        test_environment_config: EnvironmentConfig,
        mock_agent_room_metadata,
        mock_external_service_clients,
    ):
        """Test handling task interruption"""
        on_finish = AsyncMock()
        mock_agent_session.generate_reply = AsyncMock()
        orchestrator = CallScriptOrchestrator(
            call_script=sample_call_script,
            session=mock_agent_session,
            on_finish_cleanup=on_finish,
            room_name="test-room",
            config=test_environment_config,
            agent_room_metadata=mock_agent_room_metadata,
            external_service_clients=mock_external_service_clients,
        )
        # Create interrupt request
        interrupt_request = TaskAgentInterruptRequest(
            type=TaskAgentInterruptType.USER_TOPIC_CHANGE,
            interrupt_note="User changed topic",
        )

        # Test topic change doesn't end call
        await orchestrator.on_task_agent_interrupt(interrupt_request)

        # Test end call interrupt
        end_call_request = TaskAgentInterruptRequest(
            type=TaskAgentInterruptType.USER_INITIATE_END_CALL,
            interrupt_note="User wants to end call",
        )

        with patch.object(orchestrator, "done", new=AsyncMock()) as mock_done:
            await orchestrator.on_task_agent_interrupt(end_call_request)
            mock_done.assert_called_once()
            mock_agent_session.generate_reply.assert_called()

        with patch("asyncio.create_task") as mock_create_task:
            await orchestrator.on_candidate_datapoint_collected(

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_get_next_task(
        self,
        sample_call_script: CallScript,
        mock_agent_session: AgentSession[SessionDataState],

"""Unit tests for RoutingAgent router"""

import json
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock
from unittest.mock import Mock
from unittest.mock import patch

import pytest
from livekit.protocol.models import ParticipantInfo

from commons.enums import AgentType
from commons.schemas.ingest import CallKind

from commons.schemas.ingest import OutboundInputMetadata
from commons.schemas.ingest import ScreeningAgentRoomMetadata

from commons.schemas.purplefish import CreateEngagementResponse
from commons.services import ExternalServiceClients
from routing_agent.router import RoutingAgent


class TestRoutingAgentInit:
    """Test RoutingAgent initialization"""

    def test_init_sets_basic_properties(
        self,
        mock_job_context,
        mock_environment_config,
        mock_agent_monitor,
        mock_external_service_clients,
    ):
        """Test that initialization sets all basic properties correctly"""
        agent = RoutingAgent(
            mock_job_context,
            mock_environment_config,
            mock_agent_monitor,
            mock_external_service_clients,
        )

        assert agent.ctx == mock_job_context
        assert agent.environment_config == mock_environment_config
        assert agent.room_name == "test_room_123"
        assert agent.external_service_clients == mock_external_service_clients
        assert agent.input_metadata is None
        assert agent.engagement_id == ""
        assert agent.dispatching_agent == AgentType.SCREENING
        assert agent.agent_room_metadata is None

    def test_init_uses_external_service_clients(
        self,
        mock_job_context,
        mock_environment_config,
        mock_agent_monitor,
        mock_external_service_clients,
    ):
        """Test that initialization uses ExternalServiceClients correctly"""
        agent = RoutingAgent(
            mock_job_context,
            mock_environment_config,
            mock_agent_monitor,
            mock_external_service_clients,
        )

        # Verify that the agent has access to the external service clients
        assert agent.external_service_clients == mock_external_service_clients
        assert agent.external_service_clients.livekit_client is not None
        assert agent.external_service_clients.purplefish_client is not None


class TestGetInputMetadata:
    """Test _get_input_metadata method"""

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_get_input_metadata_success_outbound(
        self,
        mock_job_context,
        mock_environment_config,
        mock_agent_monitor,
        sample_outbound_metadata,
    ):
        """Test successful parsing of outbound metadata from job"""
        mock_job_context.job.metadata = json.dumps(
            sample_outbound_metadata.model_dump()
        )

        agent = RoutingAgent(
            mock_job_context,
            mock_environment_config,
            mock_agent_monitor,
            mock_external_service_clients,
        )

        result = await agent._get_input_metadata()

        assert result is not None
        assert result.kind == CallKind.OUTBOUND
        assert result.opportunity_id == "opp_789"
        assert result.candidate_phone_number == "+1234567890"

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_get_input_metadata_success_inbound(
        self,
        mock_job_context,
        mock_environment_config,
        mock_agent_monitor,
        sample_inbound_metadata,
    ):
        """Test successful parsing of inbound metadata from job"""
        mock_job_context.job.metadata = json.dumps(sample_inbound_metadata.model_dump())

        agent = RoutingAgent(
            mock_job_context,
            mock_environment_config,
            mock_agent_monitor,
            mock_external_service_clients,
        )

        result = await agent._get_input_metadata()

        assert result is not None
        assert result.kind == CallKind.INBOUND
        assert result.candidate_phone_number == "+1234567890"
        assert result.agent_phone_number == "+0987654321"

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_get_input_metadata_invalid_json(
        self,
        mock_job_context,
        mock_environment_config,
        mock_agent_monitor,

        """Test handling of invalid JSON in job metadata"""
        mock_job_context.job.metadata = "invalid json {"

        agent = RoutingAgent(
            mock_job_context,
            mock_environment_config,
            mock_agent_monitor,
            mock_external_service_clients,
        )

        result = await agent._get_input_metadata()

        assert result is None

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_get_input_metadata_none(

        mock_job_context,

        mock_agent_monitor,

        agent = RoutingAgent(

            mock_environment_config,
            mock_agent_monitor,
            mock_external_service_clients,
        )

        result = await agent._get_input_metadata()

        assert result is None


class TestGetParticipantData:

    async def test_get_participant_data_sip(
        self,
        mock_job_context,
        mock_environment_config,
        mock_agent_monitor,
        mock_external_service_clients,
        sample_sip_participant,

        agent = RoutingAgent(
            mock_job_context,
            mock_environment_config,
            mock_agent_monitor,

        result = await agent._get_participant_data()

        # Should use first participant (SIP)

class TestRoutingAgentInit:

"""Integration tests for RoutingAgent with mock HTTP server"""

import json
from unittest.mock import Mock

import pytest
from livekit.protocol.models import ParticipantInfo
from pytest_httpserver import HTTPServer

from commons.enums import AgentType
from commons.services.purplefish_client import PurplefishClient
from commons.services import ExternalServiceClients
from routing_agent.router import RoutingAgent


class TestRoutingAgentIntegration:
    """Integration tests for RoutingAgent with real HTTP mocking"""

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_full_inbound_routing_flow(
        self,
        mock_job_context,
        mock_environment_config,
        mock_agent_monitor,
        mock_external_service_clients,
        mock_purplefish_server,
        sample_sip_participant,
        sample_sip_attributes,
    ):
        """Test complete inbound call routing with real HTTP server"""
        # Setup SIP participant
        participant_details = Mock()
        participant_details.attributes = sample_sip_attributes
        mock_external_service_clients.livekit_client.list_participants.return_value = [sample_sip_participant]
        mock_external_service_clients.livekit_client.get_participant_details.return_value = participant_details

        # Update environment config to use mock server URL
        mock_environment_config.jobs_api_host = f"http://{mock_purplefish_server.server.host}:{mock_purplefish_server.server.port}"

        # Create real PurplefishClient connected to mock server
        auth_token_secret = (
            mock_environment_config.secrets.agent_auth_token_secret.get_secret_value()
            if mock_environment_config.secrets.agent_auth_token_secret
            else None
        )
        # Update the mock external_service_clients to use real PurplefishClient

"""Integration tests for RoutingAgent with mock HTTP server"""

import json
from unittest.mock import Mock

import pytest
from livekit.protocol.models import ParticipantInfo
from pytest_httpserver import HTTPServer

from commons.enums import AgentType
from commons.services.purplefish_client import PurplefishClient
from routing_agent.router import RoutingAgent


class TestRoutingAgentIntegration:
    """Integration tests for RoutingAgent with real HTTP mocking"""

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_full_inbound_routing_flow(
        self,
        mock_job_context,
        mock_environment_config,
        mock_agent_monitor,
        mock_external_service_clients,
        mock_purplefish_server,
        sample_sip_participant,
        sample_sip_attributes,
    ):
        """Test complete inbound call routing with real HTTP server"""
        # Setup SIP participant
        participant_details = Mock()
        participant_details.attributes = sample_sip_attributes
        mock_external_service_clients.livekit_client.list_participants.return_value = [
            sample_sip_participant
        ]
        mock_external_service_clients.livekit_client.get_participant_details.return_value = participant_details

        # Update environment config to use mock server URL
        mock_environment_config.jobs_api_host = f"http://{mock_purplefish_server.server.host}:{mock_purplefish_server.server.port}"

        # Create real PurplefishClient connected to mock server
        auth_token_secret = (
            mock_environment_config.secrets.agent_auth_token_secret.get_secret_value()
            if mock_environment_config.secrets.agent_auth_token_secret
            else None
        )
        # Update the mock external_service_clients to use real PurplefishClient
        mock_external_service_clients.purplefish_client = PurplefishClient(
            base_url=mock_environment_config.jobs_api_host,
            auth_token_secret=auth_token_secret,
        )

        # Create routing agent with mock external service clients
        agent = RoutingAgent(
            mock_job_context,
            mock_environment_config,
            mock_agent_monitor,
            mock_external_service_clients,
        )

        # Run routing
        await agent.route()

        # Verify engagement was created in mock server
        assert len(mock_purplefish_server.engagements) == 1

    @pytest.mark.asyncio

        mock_purplefish_server,
        sample_sip_participant,
        sample_sip_attributes,
    ):

        participant_details = Mock()

            sample_sip_participant
        ]

        # Update environment config to use mock server URL
        mock_environment_config.jobs_api_host = f"http://{mock_purplefish_server.server.host}:{mock_purplefish_server.server.port}"

        # Create real PurplefishClient connected to mock server
        auth_token_secret = (
            mock_environment_config.secrets.agent_auth_token_secret.get_secret_value()
            if mock_environment_config.secrets.agent_auth_token_secret
            else None
        )
        # Update the mock external_service_clients to use real PurplefishClient
        mock_external_service_clients.purplefish_client = PurplefishClient(
            base_url=mock_environment_config.jobs_api_host,
            auth_token_secret=auth_token_secret,
        )

        agent = RoutingAgent(
            mock_job_context,
            mock_environment_config,
            mock_agent_monitor,
            mock_external_service_clients,

                0
            ][1]
        )

        assert metadata["engagement_id"] == engagement_id
        assert metadata["input_metadata"]["kind"] == "inbound"

        # Cleanup
        await mock_external_service_clients.purplefish_client.close()

        sample_sip_attributes,

        """Test complete inbound call routing with real HTTP server"""
        # Setup SIP participant
        participant_details = Mock()
        participant_details.attributes = sample_sip_attributes
        mock_external_service_clients.livekit_client.list_participants.return_value = [
            sample_sip_participant
        ]
        mock_external_service_clients.livekit_client.get_participant_details.return_value = participant_details

        # Update environment config to use mock server URL
        mock_environment_config.jobs_api_host = f"http://{mock_purplefish_server.server.host}:{mock_purplefish_server.server.port}"

        # Create real PurplefishClient connected to mock server
        auth_token_secret = (
            mock_environment_config.secrets.agent_auth_token_secret.get_secret_value()
            if mock_environment_config.secrets.agent_auth_token_secret
            else None
        )
        # Update the mock external_service_clients to use real PurplefishClient
        mock_external_service_clients.purplefish_client = PurplefishClient(
            base_url=mock_environment_config.jobs_api_host,
            auth_token_secret=auth_token_secret,
        )

        # Create routing agent with mock external service clients
        agent = RoutingAgent(
            mock_job_context,
            mock_environment_config,
            mock_agent_monitor,
            mock_external_service_clients,
        )

        # Run routing
        await agent.route()

        # Verify engagement was created in mock server
        assert len(mock_purplefish_server.engagements) == 1
        engagement_id = list(mock_purplefish_server.engagements.keys())[0]
        engagement = mock_purplefish_server.engagements[engagement_id]

        assert engagement["roomName"] == "test_room_123"
        assert engagement["candidatePhoneNumber"] == "+1234567890"
        assert engagement["agentName"] == "screening_agent"

        # Verify room metadata was updated with engagement_id
        mock_external_service_clients.livekit_client.update_room_metadata.assert_called_once()
        metadata_json = (
            mock_external_service_clients.livekit_client.update_room_metadata.call_args[
                0
            ][1]
        )
        metadata = json.loads(metadata_json)
        assert metadata["engagement_id"] == engagement_id
        assert metadata["input_metadata"]["kind"] == "inbound"

        # Cleanup
        await mock_external_service_clients.purplefish_client.close()

"""Tests for VoiceAgentConversationContext"""

import asyncio

from livekit.api import S3Upload

class TestLogPersistenceWorker:
    """Test suite for LogPersistenceWorker"""

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_log_persistence_worker_initialization(self, tmp_path):
        """Test that log persistence worker initializes correctly"""
        log_dir = tmp_path / "test_logs"
        worker = LogPersistenceWorker(log_dir)

        assert log_dir.exists()
        assert (log_dir / "conversation.log").exists() or not (
            log_dir / "conversation.log"
        ).exists()

        await worker.stop()

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_log_item_persistence(self, tmp_path):
        """Test that items are persisted to file"""
        log_dir = tmp_path / "test_logs"
        worker = LogPersistenceWorker(log_dir)

        # Create a test log item
        test_item = RawItemLog.from_raw_data(
            name="test_event",
            data={"test": "data"},
            session=None,
            egress_monotonic_start_time=0.0,
        )

        # Log the item
        worker.log_item(test_item)

        # Give worker time to process
        await asyncio.sleep(0.1)

        # Stop worker to flush
        await worker.stop()

        # Verify file contents
        log_file = log_dir / "conversation.log"
        assert log_file.exists()

        with open(log_file, "r") as f:
            lines = f.readlines()
            assert len(lines) == 1
            logged_data = json.loads(lines[0])
            assert logged_data["name"] == "test_event"
            assert logged_data["data"]["test"] == "data"

class TestLogPersistenceWorker:
    """Test suite for LogPersistenceWorker"""

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_log_persistence_worker_initialization(self, tmp_path):
        """Test that log persistence worker initializes correctly"""
        log_dir = tmp_path / "test_logs"
        worker = LogPersistenceWorker(log_dir)

        assert log_dir.exists()
        assert (log_dir / "conversation.log").exists() or not (
            log_dir / "conversation.log"
        ).exists()

        await worker.stop()

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_log_item_persistence(self, tmp_path):
        """Test that items are persisted to file"""
        log_dir = tmp_path / "test_logs"
        worker = LogPersistenceWorker(log_dir)

        # Create a test log item
        test_item = RawItemLog.from_raw_data(
            name="test_event",
            data={"test": "data"},
            session=None,
            egress_monotonic_start_time=0.0,
        )

        # Log the item
        worker.log_item(test_item)

        # Give worker time to process
        await asyncio.sleep(0.1)

        # Stop worker to flush
        await worker.stop()

        # Verify file contents
        log_file = log_dir / "conversation.log"
        assert log_file.exists()

        with open(log_file, "r") as f:
            lines = f.readlines()
            assert len(lines) == 1
            logged_data = json.loads(lines[0])
            assert logged_data["name"] == "test_event"
            assert logged_data["data"]["test"] == "data"

from unittest.mock import AsyncMock

from livekit.protocol import sip as proto_sip

from commons.monitoring.tracer import AgentTracer
from commons.services.livekit_client import LiveKitClient


class TestLiveKitClient:
    """Test suite for LiveKitClient"""

    @pytest.fixture
    def mock_tracer(self):
        """Create a mock tracer"""
        tracer = MagicMock(spec=AgentTracer)
        tracer.get_tracer.return_value = MagicMock()
        return tracer

    @pytest.fixture
    def client(self, mock_tracer):
        """Create a LiveKitClient for testing"""
        return LiveKitClient(
            url="http://localhost:7880",
            api_key="test_key",
            api_secret="test_secret",
            agent_tracer=mock_tracer,
        )

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_make_outbound_call_success(self, client):
        """Test successful outbound call creation"""
        # Mock the SIP participant info response
        expected_response = proto_sip.SIPParticipantInfo(
            participant_id="sip_participant_123",
            participant_identity="sip-outbound-test-room-+15551234567",
            room_name="test-room",
        )

        # Mock the LiveKIT API client
        with patch.object(client, "_client") as mock_client:
            mock_sip = AsyncMock()
            mock_sip.create_sip_participant = AsyncMock(return_value=expected_response)
            mock_client.sip = mock_sip

            # Call the function
            result = await client.make_outbound_call(
                outbound_trunk_id="trunk_123",
                room_name="test-room",
                number="+15551234567",
                participant_name="Test User",
            )

            # Verify the result
            assert result == expected_response
            assert result.participant_id == "sip_participant_123"
            assert result.participant_identity == "sip-outbound-test-room-+15551234567"
            assert result.room_name == "test-room"

            # Verify the request was made with correct parameters
            mock_sip.create_sip_participant.assert_called_once()
            call_args = mock_sip.create_sip_participant.call_args[0][0]

            assert call_args.sip_trunk_id == "trunk_123"
            assert call_args.sip_call_to == "+15551234567"
            assert call_args.participant_name == "Test User"
            assert (
                call_args.participant_identity == "sip-outbound-test-room-+15551234567"
            )
            assert call_args.krisp_enabled is True

        """Test that tracing attributes are set correctly"""

            participant_id="sip_participant_456",
            participant_identity="sip-outbound-room2-+15559876543",

            mock_sip = AsyncMock()
            mock_sip.create_sip_participant = AsyncMock(return_value=expected_response)
            mock_client.sip = mock_sip

            # Mock the tracer span
            mock_span = MagicMock()
            mock_span.__enter__ = MagicMock(return_value=mock_span)
            mock_span.__exit__ = MagicMock(return_value=None)
            client.tracer.start_as_current_span = MagicMock(return_value=mock_span)

            # Call the function
            await client.make_outbound_call(
                outbound_trunk_id="trunk_456",
                room_name="room2",
                number="+15559876543",

            )

from unittest.mock import AsyncMock
from unittest.mock import MagicMock
from unittest.mock import Mock

import pytest

from commons.monitoring.tracer import AgentTracer

class TestLiveKitClient:
    """Test suite for LiveKitClient"""

    @pytest.fixture
    def client(self):
        """Create a LiveKitClient for testing"""
        return LiveKitClient(
            url="http://localhost:7880",
            api_key="test_key",
            api_secret="test_secret",
        )

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_make_outbound_call_success(self, client):
        """Test successful outbound call creation"""
        # Mock the SIP participant info response
        expected_response = proto_sip.SIPParticipantInfo(
            participant_id="sip_participant_123",
            participant_identity="sip-outbound-test-room-+15551234567",
            room_name="test-room",
        )

        # Mock the LiveKIT API client
        with patch.object(client, "_client") as mock_client:
            mock_sip = AsyncMock()
            mock_sip.create_sip_participant = AsyncMock(return_value=expected_response)
            mock_client.sip = mock_sip

            # Call the function
            result = await client.make_outbound_call(
                outbound_trunk_id="trunk_123",
                room_name="test-room",
                number="+15551234567",
                participant_name="Test User",
            )

            # Verify the result
            assert result == expected_response
            assert result.participant_id == "sip_participant_123"
            assert result.participant_identity == "sip-outbound-test-room-+15551234567"
            assert result.room_name == "test-room"

            # Verify the request was made with correct parameters
            mock_sip.create_sip_participant.assert_called_once()
            call_args = mock_sip.create_sip_participant.call_args[0][0]
            assert call_args.room_name == "test-room"
            assert call_args.sip_trunk_id == "trunk_123"
            assert call_args.sip_call_to == "+15551234567"
            assert call_args.participant_name == "Test User"
            assert (
                call_args.participant_identity == "sip-outbound-test-room-+15551234567"
            )
            assert call_args.krisp_enabled is True

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_make_outbound_call_with_tracing(self, client):
        """Test that tracing attributes are set correctly"""
        # Mock the SIP participant info response
        expected_response = proto_sip.SIPParticipantInfo(
            participant_id="sip_participant_456",
            participant_identity="sip-outbound-room2-+15559876543",
            room_name="room2",
        )

        # Mock the LiveKIT API client
        with patch.object(client, "_client") as mock_client:
            mock_sip = AsyncMock()
            mock_sip.create_sip_participant = AsyncMock(return_value=expected_response)
            mock_client.sip = mock_sip

            # Mock the tracer span
            mock_span = MagicMock()
            mock_span.__enter__ = MagicMock(return_value=mock_span)
            mock_span.__exit__ = MagicMock(return_value=None)
            client.tracer.start_as_current_span = MagicMock(return_value=mock_span)

            # Call the function
            await client.make_outbound_call(
                outbound_trunk_id="trunk_456",
                room_name="room2",
                number="+15559876543",
                participant_name="Another User",

            # Verify tracing attributes were set
            client.tracer.start_as_current_span.assert_called_once_with(
                "livekit.make_outbound_call"
            )
            mock_span.set_attribute.assert_any_call("room.name", "room2")
            mock_span.set_attribute.assert_any_call("sip.trunk_id", "trunk_456")
            mock_span.set_attribute.assert_any_call("sip.number", "+15559876543")
            mock_span.set_attribute.assert_any_call("participant.name", "Another User")
            mock_span.set_attribute.assert_any_call(
                "participant.identity", "sip-outbound-room2-+15559876543"
            )
            mock_span.set_attribute.assert_any_call(
                "sip.participant_id", "sip_participant_456"
            )

"""Tests for BaseTaskAgent"""

from unittest.mock import AsyncMock
from unittest.mock import MagicMock

import pytest

from commons.schemas.call_script import JobContext
from commons.schemas.task import BaseTaskConfiguration
from commons.schemas.task_agent import BaseTaskAgentConfiguration
from commons.schemas.task_orchestrator import OrchestratorTaskAgentContext
from commons.schemas.task_orchestrator import TaskAgentHooks
from voice_agent.task_agent.base_agent import BaseTaskAgent


class TestBaseTaskAgent:
    """Test suite for BaseTaskAgent"""

    @pytest.fixture
    def agent_config(self):
        """Create BaseTaskAgentConfiguration"""
        return BaseTaskAgentConfiguration(
            name="Test Agent",
            description="Test agent for testing",
            agent_instructions="Test instructions",
        )

    @pytest.fixture
    def task_config(self):
        """Create BaseTaskConfiguration"""
        return BaseTaskConfiguration(
            id="test_task",
            title="Test Task",
            initial_message="Welcome!",
            task_instructions="Do something important",
        )

    def test_initialization(self, agent_config, task_config, orchestrator_context):
        """Test BaseTaskAgent initialization"""
        agent = BaseTaskAgent(
            agent_config=agent_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orchestrator_context,
        )

        assert agent.agent_config == agent_config
        assert agent.task_config == task_config
        assert agent.orc_ctx == orchestrator_context
        assert "Test instructions" in agent.instructions
        assert "Do something important" in agent.instructions

    def test_initialization_with_transformer(self, task_config, orchestrator_context):
        """Test initialization with task instruction transformer"""

        def transformer(instruction, task_cfg, orc_ctx):
            return f"TRANSFORMED: {instruction}"

        agent_config = BaseTaskAgentConfiguration(
            name="Test Agent",
            description="Test agent",
            agent_instructions="Test instructions",
            task_instruction_transformer=transformer,
        )

        agent = BaseTaskAgent(
            agent_config=agent_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orchestrator_context,
        )

        assert "TRANSFORMED: Do something important" in agent.instructions

    def test_instructions_include_context(
        self, agent_config, task_config, orchestrator_context
    ):
        """Test that instructions include task context"""
        agent = BaseTaskAgent(
            agent_config=agent_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orchestrator_context,
        )

        # Check that task context is included
        assert "Outstanding tasks: [task3]" in agent.instructions
        assert "In Progress tasks: [collect_data]" in agent.instructions
        assert "Completed tasks: [greet]" in agent.instructions

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_on_enter_with_initial_message(
        self, agent_config, task_config, orchestrator_context
    ):
        """Test on_enter with initial message"""
        agent = BaseTaskAgent(
            agent_config=agent_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orchestrator_context,
        )

        # Mock session
        agent.session = MagicMock()
        agent.session.say = AsyncMock()

        await agent.on_enter()

        # Should say the initial message
        agent.session.say.assert_called_once_with(text="Welcome!", add_to_chat_ctx=True)

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_on_enter_without_initial_message(
        self, agent_config, orchestrator_context
    ):
        """Test on_enter without initial message"""
        task_config = BaseTaskConfiguration(
            id="test_task",
            title="Test Task",
            initial_message=None,  # No initial message
            task_instructions="Do something",
        )

        agent = BaseTaskAgent(
            agent_config=agent_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orchestrator_context,
        )

        # Mock session
        agent.session = MagicMock()
        agent.session.generate_reply = AsyncMock()

        await agent.on_enter()

        # Should generate a reply
        agent.session.generate_reply.assert_called_once()

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_on_task_agent_complete(
        self, agent_config, task_config, orchestrator_context
    ):
        """Test on_task_agent_complete function tool"""
        agent = BaseTaskAgent(
            agent_config=agent_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orchestrator_context,
        )

        # Mock run context
        run_context = MagicMock()

        await agent.on_task_agent_complete(
            run_context=run_context, explanation="Task completed successfully"
        )

        # Should call the hook
        orchestrator_context.task_agent_hooks.on_task_agent_finished.assert_called_once_with(
            task_config, "Task completed successfully"
        )

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_on_task_agent_interrupt(
        self, agent_config, task_config, orchestrator_context
    ):
        """Test on_task_agent_interrupt function tool"""
        from commons.enums import TaskAgentInterruptType
        from commons.schemas.task_orchestrator import TaskAgentInterruptRequest

        agent = BaseTaskAgent(
            agent_config=agent_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orchestrator_context,
        )

        # Mock run context
        run_context = MagicMock()
        run_context.userdata = MagicMock()

        interrupt_request = TaskAgentInterruptRequest(
            type=TaskAgentInterruptType.USER_TOPIC_CHANGE,
            interrupt_note="User asked about something else",
        )

        await agent.on_task_agent_interrupt(
            run_context=run_context, interrupt_request=interrupt_request
        )

        # Should set the interruption on userdata
        assert run_context.userdata.current_agent_interruption == interrupt_request

        # Should call the hook
        orchestrator_context.task_agent_hooks.on_task_agent_interrupt.assert_called_once_with(
            interrupt_request
        )

    def test_agent_configuration_merge(self):
        """Test agent configuration merge functionality"""
        base_config = BaseTaskAgentConfiguration(
            name="Base Agent",
            description="Base description",
            agent_instructions="Base instructions",
        )

        override_config = BaseTaskAgentConfiguration(
            name="Override Agent",
            description="Override description",
            agent_instructions="Override instructions",
        )

        merged = base_config.merge_config(override_config)

        assert merged.name == "Override Agent"
        assert merged.description == "Override description"
        assert merged.agent_instructions == "Override instructions"
        assert (
            merged.task_instruction_transformer
            == base_config.task_instruction_transformer
        )

"""Tests for DataCollectionAgent"""

from unittest.mock import AsyncMock
from unittest.mock import MagicMock

import pytest
from livekit.agents import AgentSession

from commons.enums import TaskAgentType
from commons.schemas.task import DataCollectionTaskConfiguration
from commons.schemas.task_agent import DataCollectionAgentConfiguration
from commons.schemas.task_orchestrator import SessionDataState
from voice_agent.task_agent.data_collection_agent import DataCollectionTaskAgent
from voice_agent.task_agent.data_collection_agent import (
    DefaultDataCollectionTaskAgentConfig,
)


class TestDataCollectionAgent:
    """Test suite for DataCollectionTaskAgent"""

    @pytest.fixture
    def agent_config(self):
        """Create DataCollectionAgentConfiguration"""
        return DataCollectionAgentConfiguration(
            name="Data Collector",
            description="Collects candidate information",
            agent_instructions="Collect data professionally",
            agent_type=TaskAgentType.DATA_COLLECTION,
        )

    @pytest.fixture
    def task_config(self):
        """Create DataCollectionTaskConfiguration"""
        return DataCollectionTaskConfiguration(
            id="collect_data",
            title="Collect Candidate Information",
            initial_message="I need to collect some information from you.",
            task_instructions="Collect name and email from the candidate",
            task_agent_type=TaskAgentType.DATA_COLLECTION,
            candidate_data_points_to_collect=["name", "email"],
        )

    def test_initialization(self, agent_config, task_config, orchestrator_context):
        """Test DataCollectionAgent initialization"""
        agent = DataCollectionTaskAgent(
            agent_config=agent_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orchestrator_context,
        )

        assert agent.agent_config.name == "Data Collector"
        assert agent.task_config.id == "collect_data"
        assert agent.orc_ctx == orchestrator_context
        assert len(agent.task_config.candidate_data_points_to_collect) == 2

    def test_default_config_merge(self, task_config, orchestrator_context):
        """Test that default config is merged with provided config"""
        custom_config = DataCollectionAgentConfiguration(
            name="Custom Collector",
            description="Custom description",
            agent_instructions="Custom instructions",
            agent_type=TaskAgentType.DATA_COLLECTION,
        )

        agent = DataCollectionTaskAgent(
            agent_config=custom_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orchestrator_context,
        )

        # Should have custom values
        assert agent.agent_config.name == "Custom Collector"
        assert agent.agent_config.description == "Custom description"

        # Should have transformer from default config
        assert agent.agent_config.task_instruction_transformer is not None

    def test_default_data_collection_config(self):
        """Test DefaultDataCollectionTaskAgentConfig values"""
        assert DefaultDataCollectionTaskAgentConfig.name == "Data Collection"
        assert (
            "collect specific data points"
            in DefaultDataCollectionTaskAgentConfig.description.lower()
        )
        assert (
            DefaultDataCollectionTaskAgentConfig.task_instruction_transformer
            is not None
        )

    async def test_collect_datapoint_tool_generation(
        self,
        agent_config,
        task_config,
        orchestrator_context,
        mock_agent_session: AgentSession[SessionDataState],
    ):
        """Test that collect_datapoint tool is generated for each data point"""
        agent = DataCollectionTaskAgent(
            agent_config=agent_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orchestrator_context,
        )

        # Should have tools for collecting data points
        # Note: The actual implementation generates these dynamically
        # This test verifies the agent is properly configured to handle data collection
        assert agent.task_config.candidate_data_points_to_collect == ["name", "email"]
        await mock_agent_session.start(agent)

        await mock_agent_session.say("")
        assert len(agent.tools) >= len(
            agent.task_config.candidate_data_points_to_collect
        )

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_on_enter_with_initial_message(
        self, agent_config, task_config, orchestrator_context
    ):
        """Test on_enter behavior with initial message"""
        agent = DataCollectionTaskAgent(
            agent_config=agent_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orchestrator_context,
        )

        # Mock session
        agent.session = MagicMock()
        agent.session.say = AsyncMock()

        await agent.on_enter()

        # Should say the initial message
        agent.session.say.assert_called_once_with(
            text="I need to collect some information from you.", add_to_chat_ctx=True
        )

    def test_instructions_include_data_points(
        self, agent_config, task_config, orchestrator_context
    ):
        """Test that instructions include data point context"""
        agent = DataCollectionTaskAgent(
            agent_config=agent_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orchestrator_context,
        )

        # Check that instructions include data collection context
        assert "collect" in agent.instructions.lower()
        assert "name" in agent.instructions
        assert "email" in agent.instructions

    async def test_task_completion_with_collected_data(
        self, agent_config, task_config, orchestrator_context
    ):
        """Test data collection task completion"""
        agent = DataCollectionTaskAgent(
            agent_config=agent_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orchestrator_context,
        )

        # Mock run context
        run_context = MagicMock()

        await agent.on_task_agent_complete(
            run_context=run_context, explanation="Successfully collected name and email"
        )

        # Should call the completion hook
        orchestrator_context.task_agent_hooks.on_task_agent_finished.assert_called_once_with(
            task_config, "Successfully collected name and email"
        )

        self, agent_config, task_config, orchestrator_context

            agent_config=agent_config,
            task_config=task_config,

            interrupt_note="User refuses to provide email",

            run_context=run_context, interrupt_request=interrupt_request
        )

        # Should handle the interruption
        orchestrator_context.task_agent_hooks.on_task_agent_interrupt.assert_called_once_with(
            interrupt_request
        )

        agent = DataCollectionTaskAgent(
            agent_config=agent_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orchestrator_context,
        )

        assert agent.agent_config.agent_type == TaskAgentType.DATA_COLLECTION
        assert agent.task_config.task_agent_type == TaskAgentType.DATA_COLLECTION

    def test_with_validation_strategies(
        self, agent_config, orchestrator_context, candidate_data_schemas
    ):
        """Test data collection with validation strategies"""
        from commons.enums import TaskValidationType
        from commons.schemas.task import TaskDatapointQueryValidationStrategy

        task_config = DataCollectionTaskConfiguration(
            id="collect_data",
            title="Collect and Validate",
            task_instructions="Collect and validate data",
            task_agent_type=TaskAgentType.DATA_COLLECTION,
            candidate_data_points_to_collect=["name", "email"],
            validations=[

                    strategy=TaskValidationType.CANDIDATE_DATA_POINT_QUERY,

            agent_config=agent_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orchestrator_context,
        )

        assert len(agent.task_config.validations) == 1
        assert agent.task_config.validations[0].query == "$.email"

    def test_with_all_data_points(
        self, agent_config, orchestrator_context, candidate_data_schemas
    ):
        """Test collecting all available data points"""
        task_config = DataCollectionTaskConfiguration(
            id="collect_all",
            title="Collect All Data",
            task_instructions="Collect all candidate information",
            task_agent_type=TaskAgentType.DATA_COLLECTION,
            candidate_data_points_to_collect=["name", "email", "phone"],
        )

        agent = DataCollectionTaskAgent(
            agent_config=agent_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orchestrator_context,
        )

        assert len(agent.task_config.candidate_data_points_to_collect) == 3
        assert "phone" in agent.task_config.candidate_data_points_to_collect

class TestQATaskAgent:
    """Test suite for QATaskAgent"""

    @pytest.fixture
    def agent_config(self):
        """Create QATaskAgentConfiguration"""
        return QATaskAgentConfiguration(
            name="Test QA Agent",
            description="Answers user questions",
            agent_instructions="Answer questions accurately",
            agent_type=TaskAgentType.QA,
        )

    @pytest.fixture
    def task_config(self):
        """Create QATaskConfiguration"""
        return QATaskConfiguration(
            id="qa_task",
            title="Question and Answer",
            initial_message="Do you have any questions about the role?",
            task_instructions="Answer questions about the job position",
            task_agent_type=TaskAgentType.QA,
        )

    def test_initialization(self, agent_config, task_config, orchestrator_context):
        """Test QATaskAgent initialization"""
        agent = QATaskAgent(
            agent_config=agent_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orchestrator_context,
        )

        assert agent.agent_config.name == "Test QA Agent"
        assert agent.task_config.id == "qa_task"
        assert agent.orc_ctx == orchestrator_context

    def test_default_config_merge(self, task_config, orchestrator_context):
        """Test that default config is merged with provided config"""
        custom_config = QATaskAgentConfiguration(
            name="Custom QA",
            description="Custom Q&A description",
            agent_instructions="Custom Q&A instructions",
            agent_type=TaskAgentType.QA,
        )

        agent = QATaskAgent(
            agent_config=custom_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orchestrator_context,
        )

        # Should have custom values
        assert agent.agent_config.name == "Custom QA"
        assert agent.agent_config.description == "Custom Q&A description"

        # Should have transformer from default config
        assert agent.agent_config.task_instruction_transformer is not None

    def test_default_qa_config(self):
        """Test DefaultQATaskAgentConfig values"""
        assert DefaultQATaskAgentConfig.name == "QA Agent"
        assert (
            DefaultQATaskAgentConfig.description
            == "Agent that can answer questions from candidates"
        )
        assert (
            DefaultQATaskAgentConfig.agent_instructions
            == "You are a question and answer agent that provides accurate facts to candidates."
        )
        assert DefaultQATaskAgentConfig.task_instruction_transformer is not None

    def test_task_instruction_transformer(self, task_agent_hooks):
        """Test the task instruction transformer"""

        transformer = DefaultQATaskAgentConfig.task_instruction_transformer
        assert transformer is not None

        # Create dummy objects for the transformer
        dummy_task = BaseTaskConfiguration(
            id="test", title="Test Task", task_instructions="Test QA instructions"
        )
        dummy_context = OrchestratorTaskAgentContext(
            task_agent_hooks=task_agent_hooks,
            job_details=JobContext(
                title="Software Developer",
                description="Backend development role",
                company="Tech Inc",
            ),
            candidate_data_point_schemas={},
            outstanding_task_ids=[],
            in_progress_task_ids=[],
            completed_task_ids=[],
        )

        result = transformer("Original QA instruction", dummy_task, dummy_context)

        assert "Original QA instruction" in result
        assert "Here are all information about the role:" in result
        assert "Your task:" in result

        assert "Never end the call or say goodbye" in result
